verdict.rationale: Increase documents rail-level data access, including ACH Addenda and other network details, low-level access to the underlying rails, and an API that mirrors the networks without an abstraction layer. It also automatically correlates returns with their originating transfers, and per-counterparty Account Numbers let inbound credits be matched to their sender. That covers rail-specific metadata and a form of counterparty attribution, but not the enrichment layer the story asks for. missing for 10: documented transaction enrichment (merchant/counterparty cleaning, categorization), explicit counterparty-detail fields on transaction objects, explicit stable transaction identifier documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of data richness.
